# Security Policy

Please **do not** open public issues for security vulnerabilities.

Report them privately through GitHub: **Security → Report a vulnerability**
(<https://github.com/PiniPP/credorbit/security/advisories/new>).

Include the CredOrbit version (`credorbit version`), your OS, and steps to reproduce.
Never include real credentials, SSO tokens, account IDs or start URLs — redact them.

Supported versions: the latest release receives security fixes.

The full security model (what CredOrbit writes, file permissions, token handling and
redaction) is documented in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
